name: Bcl Industries Ltd.
summary: BCL Industries Limited operates as a diversified agro-processing and manufacturing enterprise, primarily within India. Its core activities encompass edible oil production, rice milling, grain-based distillation, and real estate development. The company structures its operations into three primary segments: Oil & Vanaspati, Distillery, and Real Estate. Through these divisions, BCL Industries delivers a variety of products, including edible oils, vanaspati ghee, alcoholic beverages, extra neutral alcohol (ENA), and ethanol. Additionally, its real estate arm undertakes the construction of residential properties. Founded in 1976, the company's main office is situated in Chandigarh, India.
